name: 359-hide-seek
notes: #359 B3.c hide and seek: four kids, a tent as the base, two bushes, a tree and another tent within 1 u as cover. View/Beats/KidPlay2.cs HideSeekGame: the seeker counts facing the tent, hands over its eyes, bobbing (4 s); the others run each to its own cover and crouch on the far side from the base, peeking out now and then; the seeker turns, walks round looking left and right, to the nearest first; beside a hider it points and hops (the Contact): the hider pops up (stretch, hop, arms up) and races back to touch the tent; the last found, the seeker runs back too and everyone cheers (the end beat). HitFx: the bush shakes as a kid dives behind it and as it pops up. AnimLab: cheat 'Kids play: hide and seek' (needs a tent, tree or the pile with 2+ cover within 1 u).
